title: Conflict between laws.
bodyText: If a conflict between any provision of this chapter and any federal law or regulation relating to metropolitan planning organizations arises, federal law or regulation shall govern.
bodyHtml: [§279D-10]  Conflict between laws.  If a conflict between any provision of this chapter and any federal law or regulation relating to metropolitan planning organizations arises, federal law or regulation shall govern. [L 2015, c 132, pt of §1]
